blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual generative models are trained to capture the probability distributions of natural images, yet whether their native priors reflect the regularities governing human perception of image naturalness remains an open question. Here, we probe these priors through native prediction errors across 25 open image and video generators. Because raw single-image losses are dominated by scene content and visual complexity, we evaluate directional loss differences using content-preserving, paired relational interventions that selectively disrupt facial configurations or physical illumination consistency while limiting changes in low-level image statistics. Across both domains, these loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances, capturing the classic Thatcher effect on faces and shape-dependent responses to illumination inconsistencies. Notably, these loss differences reliably track continuous gradations of human naturalness judgments across individual stimulus pairs (peaking at r = .84 r=.84 on faces and .64 .64 on physical scenes) and retain unique human-aligned signals even after controlling for feature distances from frozen vision encoders and standard image quality metrics. We also find that while overall sensitivity to these violations broadly covaries with human alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity, revealing that human-like naturalness judgments dissociate from generic violation detection. Together, these findings demonstrate that learning visual distributions yields generative loss landscapes that capture distinct aspects of human naturalness perception.
blocks.zh: 视觉基因模型被训练来捕捉自然图像的概率分布,然而其原生前科是否反映了人类对图像自然性感知的规律性,仍然是一个有待解决的问题. 在这里,我们调查这些前科 通过本地的预测错误 通过25个开放的图像和视频生成器。 由于原始的单相相片损失以场景内容和视觉复杂性为主,我们使用内容保存,配对的关系干预来评价方向损失差异,这些干预有选择地打乱了面部配置或物理发光一致性,同时限制了低等图像统计的变化. 在这两个领域,这些损失差异复制了类似于人类的选择性敏感性和耐受性,捕捉了撒切尔对面部的经典影响,以及对发光不一致的依赖形状的反应。 值得注意的是,这些损失差异可靠地跟踪了个人刺激对人自然性判断的连续分级(在面部显示为r =.84 r =.84,在物理场景显示为64.64),并保留了独特的与人相通的信号,甚至在控制了从被冻结的视觉编码器和标准图像质量测量仪的特性距离之后。 我们还发现,虽然对这些侵犯行为的总体敏感性与不同模式的人类一致性大相径庭,但两者在去名时间表上有条不紊地脱钩,调整的高峰早于敏感性,揭示出类似人类的自然判断与一般性侵权检测无关。 这些调查结果共同表明,学习视觉分布产生基因损失地貌,能够捕捉人类自然感的不同方面.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Human perception of image naturalness draws heavily on sensitivity to the statistical regularities of natural visual environments: cognitive theories formalize this as inference against internal distributional priors acquired through visual experience ( Yuille & Kersten, 2006 ) . Just as human vision relies on approximate statistical expectations rather than exact physical simulation, visual generative models produce strikingly realistic images from learned image distributions while frequently violating strict physical and geometric constraints ( Farid, 2022 ; Sarkar et al., 2024 ) . This parallel raises the possibility that generative priors, learned from visual distributions rather than explicit physical simulation, naturally capture the selective sensitivities and tolerances of human vision.
blocks.zh: 人类对图像自然性的认知在很大程度上借鉴了对自然视觉环境统计规律的敏感性:认知理论将这一点正式确定为与通过视觉经验获得的内部分布前科的推论(Yuille & Kersten, 2006). 正如人类的视觉依赖于近似统计预期而不是精确的物理模拟,视觉遗传模型从所学的图像分布中产生出惊人的现实的图像,同时经常违反严格的物理和几何限制(Farid,2022;Sarkar等,2024.). 这种平行现象产生了一种可能性,即从视觉分布而不是明显的物理模拟中汲取遗传学前科,自然地捕捉出人类视觉的选择性敏感性和耐受性.

blocks.en: Prior studies utilizing generative models for perceptual assessment have largely treated them as feature extractors, training supervised regressors on internal activations ( Fu et al., 2024 ; Raviv & Chechik, 2024 ) or engineering tuning-free attention-based metrics ( Song et al., 2025 ) . To test whether generative models naturally internalize human-aligned perceptual regularities without relying on such task-specific readouts, we turn directly to their native prediction objectives. In diffusion and flow architectures, denoising and velocity losses relate to score matching and variational bounds on data log-likelihood ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Kingma & Gao, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) , providing an empirical surrogate for negative log-likelihood that reflects an image’s plausibility under the learned distribution ( Clark & Jaini, 2023 ) . We therefore evaluate whether these native prediction errors directly track human naturalness ratings in a zero-shot manner, probing the perceptual sensitivities captured by native generative prediction objectives.
blocks.zh: 以往利用基因模型进行感知评估的研究大多将它们视为特征提取器,对受监督的后退器进行内部活化培训(Fu等,2024;Raviv & Chichik, 2024)或基于工程的无听觉量度(Song等,2025)。 为了检验基因模型是否自然地将人与人相适应的观念规律内在化而不依赖于这种特定任务读取,我们直接转向其本土预测目标. 在扩散和流量架构中,去诺和速度损失与数据日志相近的分数匹配和可变界限有关(Ho等,2020;Kingma & Gao等,2023;Esser等,2024),为负的日志相近提供了经验性代词,反映了所学分布下图像的可信度(Clark & Jaini等,2023). 因此,我们评价这些原生预测错误是否以零射出的方式直接跟踪人类的自然性评级,检验原生基因预测目标所捕获的感知敏感性.

blocks.en:
Evaluating native loss directly, however, faces a known obstacle: high-dimensional density estimates and unconditioned prediction errors are sensitive to low-level image complexity, background statistics, and data geometry, which can decouple density from perceived plausibility ( Nalisnick et al., 2019 ; Serrà et al., 2020 ; Ren et al., 2019 ; Kamkari et al., 2024 ) . Consistent with these concerns, in our control evaluation on a standard distortion benchmark (CSIQ ( Larson & Chandler, 2010 ) ), native prediction errors fail to track human quality judgments across distortion types, and removing visual elements like cast shadows can lower loss even though the scene becomes physically unnatural (Appendix F ). To separate relational plausibility from low-level statistical shifts, we adopt psychophysical paradigms based on content-preserving relational interventions ( Thompson, 1980 ; Ostrovsky et al., 2005 ; Nightingale et al., 2019 ) .
Instead of adding or deleting objects, our manipulations alter spatial or physical configurations by reflecting existing image elements, which leaves coarse image statistics largely intact. The paired directional loss difference ( L modified − L original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}} ) then controls for shared scene composition, focusing evaluation on whether the model penalizes the relational violations that reduce human-perceived naturalness.
blocks.zh:
然而,直接评估原生损失面临一个已知障碍:高维密度估计和无条件的预测错误对低等图像复杂度,背景统计,以及数据几何十分敏感,可以将密度与所感知的可信度脱钩(Nalisnick等,2019;Serrà等,2020;Ren等,2019;Kamkari等,2024). 根据这些关切,在我们对标准扭曲基准(CSIQ(Larson & Chandler,2010年))的控制评价中,本土预测错误无法跟踪人类质量判断跨扭曲类型,而去除像投影这样的视觉元素即使场景变得不自然也能降低损失(Appendix F. 为了将关系合理性与低层次统计变化区分开来,我们采用了基于内容保留关系干预的心理物理范式(Thompson,1980年;Ostrovsky等,2005年;Nightingale等,2019年)。
我们的操纵不是增加或删除物体,而是通过反映现有的图像元素来改变空间或物理配置,这使得粗糙的图像统计基本完好无损. 配对方向损失差(L修改-L原L_{\mathrm{已修改-L_{\mathrm{原作-L_{\mathrm{原作-)后控制了共享场景组成,重点评价该模型是否惩罚了降低人感天性的关系侵权.

blocks.en: We evaluate this approach across two controlled domains: the Thatcher face task (feature inversions in upright and inverted faces) and the Illumination task (shadow, reflection, and light-direction interventions in rendered scenes; Figure 1 ). In representative response profiles, paired generative loss differences capture characteristic human perceptual patterns, including the classic Thatcher effect and shape-dependent shadow sensitivities, while also revealing specific divergences (Figure 1 B). To test whether these correspondences reflect systematic perceptual alignment, we evaluate 25 open image and video generators on individual stimulus pairs, comparing native loss differences against human naturalness ratings, 12 frozen vision and multimodal encoders, and ten standard image quality metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个控制领域来评价这一方法:撒切尔面部任务(直立和倒向面部的特异性倒置)和光照任务(阴影、反射和在场景中的光向干预;图1)。 在有代表性的反应剖面中,成对的基因损失差异捕捉出人类特有的认知模式,包括经典撒切尔效应和以形状为依存的阴影敏感性,同时也揭示出具体的差异(图1 B). 为了测试这些函证是否反映了系统性的知觉对接,我们用单个刺激对来评价25个开放的图像和视频生成器,比较原生损失差异与人类自然性评级,12个被冻结的视觉和多模式编码器,以及10个标准图像质量度量.

blocks.en:
Our investigation yields three primary findings. First, zero-shot directional loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances across representative physical and face conditions. Across individual items, these loss differences reliably track continuous human ratings (peaking at r = .84 r=.84 on faces and .64 .64 on physical scenes) and concentrate spatially within manipulated scene regions. Second, top generative models achieve higher human alignment than standard image quality metrics and frozen vision encoders, and retain non-redundant perceptual signals in bidirectional partial correlation analyses. Third, while coarse violation sensitivity broadly covaries with perceptual alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity.
Together, our work provides empirical evidence for a functional convergence between visual generative priors and human perception, showing that modern generative loss landscapes capture key aspects of the selective sensitivities and tolerances of human naturalness judgments.
blocks.zh:
我们的调查得出了三个主要结论。 首先,零射向损失差异在具有代表性的物理和相貌条件中复制出人样的选择性敏感性和耐受性。 在单个项目中,这些损失差异可靠地跟踪人类的持续评级(在面部显示为:r=.84 r=.84,在物理场景显示为:64.64),并在空间上集中在被操纵的场景区域。 第二,顶级基因模型比标准图像质量度量和被冻结的视觉编码器实现更高的人相接,并在双向部分相关分析中保留了非冗余感知信号. 第三,虽然粗糙的侵犯敏感度与不同模型之间的感知一致,但两者在解密时间表上有条不紊地脱钩,调整的高峰早于敏感度。
我们的工作共同为视觉遗传学前科和人类认知之间的功能趋同提供了经验证据,表明现代遗传丧失地貌捕捉了人类自然判断的选择性敏感性和耐受性的关键方面.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Generative Models as Perceptual Priors
blocks.zh: 2.1 基因模型作为概念前传

blocks.en: Evaluating departures from natural image statistics is a long-standing approach in perceptual assessment. Classical no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) measures distortions as deviations from parametric models of natural scene statistics ( Mittal et al., 2012 ; Mittal et al., 2013 ; Saad et al., 2012 ) . From a Bayesian perspective, visual quality assessment formalizes this principle as statistical inference against learned priors of natural visual environments ( Duanmu et al., 2021 ) , echoing cognitive theories of biological vision as Bayesian inference or inverse graphics ( Yuille & Kersten, 2006 ; Yildirim et al., 2020 ) . Modern deep generative models scale this principle by fitting high-dimensional distributions directly on large image corpora. However, raw density estimates and unconditioned prediction errors do not directly track perceptual quality. Likelihood-based deep models frequently assign higher likelihoods to out-of-distribution inputs than to in-distribution training data ( Nalisnick et al., 2019 ; Kirichenko et al., 2020 ) , reflecting sensitivity to input complexity ( Serrà et al., 2020 ) , background statistics ( Ren et al., 2019 ) , and manifold geometry ( Kamkari et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 评估偏离自然图像统计的情况,是概念评估中长期存在的方法. 经典的不参考图像质量评估(NR-IQA)衡量扭曲情况,作为自然场景统计参数模型的偏差(Mittal等人,2012年;Mittal等人,2013年;Saad等人,2012年)。 从巴耶斯人的角度来看,视觉质量评估将这一原则正式确定为对自然视觉环境的学前论的统计推论(Duanmu等,2021年),将生物视觉的认知理论与巴耶斯人的推论或反向图形相呼应(Yuille & Kersten,2006年;Yildirim等,2020年)。 现代深层基因模型通过将高维分布直接接入于大成像体上来放大这一原则. 然而,原始密度估计和无条件的预测错误并没有直接跟踪知觉质量. 以可能为基础的深层模型经常给分配外输入提供的可能性大于分配内培训数据(Nalisnick等,2019年;Kirichenko等,2020年),反映了对输入复杂性的敏感性(Serrà等,2020年),背景统计(Ren等,2019年),以及多种几何学(Kamkari等,2024年).

blocks.en: To bypass these density confounds, recent approaches treat generative models as feature extractors, using supervised regressors on internal activations ( Fu et al., 2024 ; Raviv & Chechik, 2024 ) or tuning-free attention correspondences ( Song et al., 2025 ) . While effective for metric engineering, these feature-derived methods do not evaluate whether the model’s learned distribution itself aligns with human naturalness perception. Rather than engineering an applied IQA metric, our goal is a scientific inquiry: testing whether human perceptual priors are reflected directly within the native loss landscapes of generative models, using content-preserving relational interventions to probe prediction errors without intermediate readouts.
blocks.zh: 为了绕过这些密度的困惑,最近的方法将基因模型作为特征提取器,在内部活化时使用有监督的后退器(Fu等人,2024;Raviv & Chechik, 2024)或无调谐注意函(Song等人,2025.). 这些特异性衍生方法虽然对衡量工程有效,但并不评价模型的所学分布本身是否与人类自然感相符合。 我们的目标不是设计一个应用的IQA指标,而是科学调查:测试人类的感知前科是否直接反映在基因模型的原生损失地貌中,利用内容保存关系干预来探测没有中间读取的预测错误.

blocks.en: 2.2 Physical World Models vs. Perceptual Naturalness
blocks.zh: 2.2 物理世界模型与认知自然

blocks.en: Several recent benchmarks evaluate whether generative models learn physical and causal regularities as predictive world models. While VideoPhy evaluates physical commonsense in video generation ( Bansal et al., 2025 ) and Physics-IQ tests real-world physical continuation ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) , LikePhys ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and YoCausal ( Xie et al., 2026 ) use paired denoising-loss contrasts to test model preferences for physically valid or temporally plausible sequences, verifying their benchmarks against aggregate human model rankings. However, adherence to objective physical laws does not directly imply alignment with human perceptual naturalness. Psychophysical studies demonstrate that human observers frequently fail to detect or tolerate substantial physical inconsistencies in lighting, shadows, and reflections ( Mamassian, 2004 ; Ostrovsky et al., 2005 ; Cavanagh, 2005 ; Wilder et al., 2019 ; Nightingale et al., 2019 ) . A model that strictly penalizes all physical departures may therefore diverge from human naturalness judgments. Rather than evaluating whether models act as strict physical simulators, our Illumination task examines whether generative loss landscapes mirror the selective tolerances that characterize human perception, testing item-level correspondence with continuous human naturalness ratings under controlled physical interventions.
blocks.zh: 最近的一些基准评价基因模型是否学习物理和因果规律作为预测性世界模型。 当视频时 Phy评价视频生成中的物理常识(Bansal等,2025年)和物理-智商测试现实世界物理延续(Motamed等,2026年),例如: Phys (Yuan等, 2026年)和YoCausal (Xie等, 2026年)使用配对的去诺能-损失对比来测试模型偏好,以测试物理上有效或时间上可行的序列,对照人类模型综合排名来验证其基准. 然而,遵守客观的物理定律并不直接意味着与人的认知自然相一致. 心理物理研究表明,人类观察者往往无法发现或容忍在照明、阴影和反射方面的重大物理不一致(Mamassian,2004年;Ostrovsky等,2005年;Cavanagh,2005年;Wilder等,2019年;Nightingale等,2019年)。 因此,严格惩罚所有身体离开的模型可能不同于对人类自然性的判断。 我们的光照任务不是评价模型是否充当严格的物理模拟器,而是审查基因损失地貌是否反映了人类认知的选择性耐受性,在受控物理干预下测试与人类持续自然性评级的品位对应.

blocks.en: 2.3 Visual Illusions in Deep Networks
blocks.zh: 2.3 深层网络的视觉幻觉

blocks.en: Visual illusions and perceptual biases provide a classic benchmark for testing whether artificial neural networks reproduce biological visual phenomena ( Gómez-Villa et al., 2020 ; Jacob et al., 2021 ; Shahgir et al., 2024 ) . Prior computational studies have investigated these effects across several paradigms: convolutional filters adapt to natural statistics to reproduce low-level brightness illusions ( Gómez-Villa et al., 2020 ) , networks trained on edge-based image reconstruction replicate surface filling-in illusions ( Saha et al., 2026 ) , and diffusion models reveal human-like brightness shifts along their DDIM inversion trajectories ( Gómez-Villa et al., 2025 ) . In higher-level perception, configural phenomena such as the Thatcher illusion have been investigated in feedforward neural networks ( Jacob et al., 2021 ) , while structured inverse graphics models have captured other face-perception illusions such as the hollow-face effect ( Yildirim et al., 2020 ) . In addition, multimodal benchmarks probe illusions via linguistic question answering ( Shahgir et al., 2024 ) . Extending this line of inquiry, we test whether characteristic human perceptual biases are expressed directly within the native loss landscapes of visual generative models.
blocks.zh: 视觉幻觉和视觉偏见为测试人工神经网络是否复制生物视觉现象提供了经典基准(Gómez-Villa等,2020年;Jacob等,2021年;Shahgir等,2024年). 先前的计算研究调查了这些影响跨越了多个范式:演化滤波器适应自然统计,以再现低等亮度错觉(Gómez-Villa等,2020年),边缘图像重建培训网络再现地表填充错觉(Saha等,2026年),传播模型沿其DDIM逆向轨迹揭示出人相亮度变化(Gómez-Villa等,2025年). 在更高层次的认知中,撒切尔幻觉等相貌现象在向导神经网络中被调查(Jacob等,2021年),而结构化倒向图形模型则捕捉出其他相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相貌相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 此外,多式联运基准通过语言问答来探寻幻觉(Shahgir等,2024.). 在扩大这一调查范围时,我们检验人类特有的观念偏见是否直接表现在视觉遗传模型的原生丧失地貌中。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Stimulus Design and Psychophysical Experiments
blocks.zh: 3.1 刺激设计和心理物理实验

blocks.en: Probing human naturalness perception across two domains. To investigate whether generative priors reflect human naturalness perception, we examine two distinct visual domains: face configurations and physical scene illumination. In face perception, observers exhibit pronounced orientation dependence: in the Thatcher illusion, inverted eyes and mouth appear grotesque in an upright face, but this distortion becomes difficult to detect when the entire face is inverted ( Thompson, 1980 ; de Haas & Schwarzkopf, 2018 ) . Testing Thatcherized faces evaluates whether generative models detect these localized feature inversions and whether their sensitivity exhibits orientation dependence. In physical scenes, observers can fail to detect substantial inconsistencies in illumination, shadows, and reflections ( Mamassian, 2004 ; Ostrovsky et al., 2005 ; Cavanagh, 2005 ; Wilder et al., 2019 ; Nightingale et al., 2019 ) . Testing illumination interventions determines whether models identify physical inconsistencies at all, and whether their responses reflect physical mechanics strictly or follow human perceptual tolerances and naturalness ratings.
blocks.zh: 探索人类自然认知跨越两个领域. 为了调查基因前科是否反映了人类的自然感知,我们考察了两个截然不同的视觉领域:相貌配置和物理场景发光. 在面相感想中,观察者表现出了明显的定向依赖性:在撒切尔幻觉中,倒向的眼睛和口在直立的面相中显得怪异,但是当整个面相被倒向时这种扭曲变得难以被察觉(Thompson, 1980; de Haas & Schwarzkopf, 2018). 测试 撒切尔化的面孔评价了基因模型是否检测出这些局部特征倒置,以及它们的敏感性是否表现出取向依赖. 在物理场景中,观察者可能无法检测出在光照,阴影和反射中的重大不一致(Mamassian,2004;Ostrovsky等,2005;Cavanagh,2005;Wilder等,2019;Nightingale等,2019). 测试发光干预决定了模型是否识别出物理上的不一致,以及其反应是严格地反映物理力学还是遵循了人类的知觉耐受性和自然性评级.

blocks.en: Content-preserving relational interventions. To probe relational regularities while limiting low-level statistical shifts, we design two tasks using content-preserving relational interventions . Existing image content is rearranged while depicted objects remain in place, avoiding object deletion or insertion. This design largely preserves color distributions and edge content, reducing the density confounds observed in evaluation of raw native losses. The Thatcher task contains 140 public-domain face scenes from FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) , modified by in-place landmark-guided vertical reflection of the eye and mouth regions ( Alimohammadi, 2020 ) using dlib-based facial landmark detection ( King, 2009 ; Kazemi & Sullivan, 2014 ) and presented upright and inverted (280 original–modified pairs; Appendix A ). The Illumination task contains 96 scenes rendered in Kubric ( Greff et al., 2022 ) each for cast-shadow, reflection, and light-direction interventions (288 pairs): for shadow and reflection conditions, the rendered floor region was mirrored to exchange shadows or reflections while objects remained fixed; for the light-direction condition, the central object was horizontally mirrored while the flanking objects and floor, including any cast shadows, remained unchanged. To produce graded item difficulty, we varied object geometry, orientation or color, height, material, and lighting parameters across scenes (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 内容保留关系干预. 为了探究关系规律,同时限制低层次的统计变化,我们利用内容保留关系干预设计了两项任务。 已存在的图像内容在被描绘对象保持原位的同时被重新排列,避免对象被删除或被插入. 这种设计在很大程度上保留了色彩分布和边缘内容,降低了在评价原始本土损失时观察到的密度混乱. 撒切尔任务包含来自FFHQ(Karras等,2019年)的140个公共域面场景,由以dlib为基础的面部地标检测(King,2009;Kazemi和Sullivan,2014年)对眼和口区域进行内地地地标引导垂直反射(Alimohammadi,2020年)所修改,并呈现出直立和倒置(280个正对;附录A). 照明任务包含由Kubric(Greff等,2022年)所制作的96个场景,每个场景用于铸影,反射和光向干预(288对): 对于阴影和反射条件,被制成的地层区域被反射来交换阴影或反射,而物体仍然固定;对于光向条件,中心物体被横向反射,而侧面物体和地层,包括任何铸影,则保持不变. 为了产生分级项目难度,我们不同对象几何,取向或颜色,高度,材料,以及跨场景的照明参数(附录A.).

blocks.en: Human psychophysical experiments. Human observers rated the naturalness of each image on a 5-point scale (1: very unnatural to 5: natural ) in online psychophysical experiments. Each trial presented a single image (Figure 1 A). In the Thatcher task, each observer viewed upright and inverted faces from different identity sets, whereas illumination conditions were tested between subjects. In both tasks, original and modified versions of each scene were evaluated by the same observer across separate, randomized trials (Appendix B ). Following response-consistency screening (143 observers retained for Thatcher, 105 for Illumination), each item received an average of 35.8 ratings in Thatcher and 26.2 in Illumination. blocks.en: 3.4 Baseline Models
blocks.zh: 3.4 基线模式

blocks.en: We compare generative scores with a prespecified pool of 12 frozen image encoders (24M–8.1B parameters) and two five-metric IQA batteries (Appendix D ). The encoder panel includes ResNet-50 ( He et al., 2016 ) , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , DINOv2/v3 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , PE-Core ( Bolya et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3-VL-Embedding ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and Jina CLIP v2 ( Koukounas et al., 2024 ) . Encoder scores use cosine distances between global vectors, or the mean distance between corresponding spatial patches for DINOv2/v3, capturing representational divergence across paired images. We evaluate representations across all intermediate blocks alongside each model’s default final output, extracting features via fixed architecture-specific pooling (Appendix D ). For each encoder and task, we select the candidate with the highest Pearson correlation with human judgments. While this post-hoc layer selection deliberately favors the encoder baselines over zero-shot generative scores, fixed feature distances measure the magnitude of change rather than the direction of degradation. Thus, they serve as a diagnostic baseline rather than an upper bound on encoder representations. The IQA batteries comprise FR-IQA (PSNR, SSIM, VIF, LPIPS, DISTS; Wang et al., 2004 ; Sheikh & Bovik, 2006 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ; Ding et al., 2022 ) and NR-IQA (NIQE, BRISQUE, HyperIQA, MUSIQ, LIQE; Mittal et al., 2013 ; Mittal et al., 2012 ; Su et al., 2020 ; Ke et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ).

blocks.en: To test whether generative loss differences capture human-aligned naturalness judgments that provide non-redundant information relative to standard image quality metrics and high-level visual encoders, we evaluate human alignment and bidirectional partial correlations against top-performing baselines. After selecting each encoder’s best-performing layer, we assess human alignment across candidate models, retaining the top five Generative models and top five Encoders alongside all five metrics from each prespecified IQA battery. For every selected generative–encoder pair ( G , X ) (G,X) , we compute r ⁡ ( h , G ∣ X ) r(h,G\mid X) and r ⁡ ( h , X ∣ G ) r(h,X\mid G) , summarizing each 5 × 5 5\times 5 comparison by its medians. Top-five models are selected over each entire task and retained, together with the selected encoder layers, across its conditions (Appendix I ). To account for selection uncertainty, confidence intervals are estimated via 10,000 participant-and-scene bootstrap resamples, repeating layer selection followed by model selection within each draw (Appendix E.3 ).

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Qualitative Validation of Generative Losses
blocks.zh: 4.1 基因损失定性鉴定

blocks.en: We first examined standardized unnaturalness profiles across representative stimulus manipulations (Figure 1 B). In the Thatcher task, humans and top generative models strongly penalized upright facial feature inversions, with sensitivity dropping sharply under inversion (Figure 1 B; top-five generative median: 2.44 2.44 upright vs. 0.91 0.91 inverted; across all 25 models, median sensitivity was 2.24 2.24 vs. 0.84 0.84 ; humans: 2.73 2.73 vs. 1.09 1.09 ; Appendix G ). In the Illumination task, generative model losses tracked human unnaturalness across scene geometry: for cast shadows, both humans and models showed pronounced sensitivity to shadow rotations for objects with distinctive directional landmarks (e.g., teapot), but remained tolerant for shapes lacking prominent in-plane asymmetries (e.g., Spot; Figure 1 B). Crucially, top vision encoders failed to capture this selective sensitivity, showing uniformly low responses across both objects ( 0.28 0.28 vs. 0.27 0.27 ), and similarly missed human sensitivity to light-direction changes on simple spheres (Figure 1 B). Conversely, human and model responses diverged on reflection color: whereas humans strongly penalized subtle hue mismatches, generative models showed relatively weak sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查了代表性刺激操纵的标准化非自然特征(图1 B)。 在撒切尔任务中,人类和顶级基因模型对直立面部特征倒置有强烈的处罚,在倒置下敏感度急剧下降(图1 B;前五位基因中位数:2.44 2.44直立对0.91 0.91倒置;在所有25个模型中,中位敏感度为2.24 2.24对0.84 0.84;人:2.73 2.73对1.09;附录G.). 在"光照"任务中,基因模型丢失跟踪了人类在场景几何上的不自然性:对于被铸造的阴影来说,人类和模型都对具有明显方向地标(如取茶壶)的物体的影子旋转表现出了显著的敏感性,但对缺乏显著的平面不对称的形状(如Spot;图1 B)仍然宽容. 关键的是,顶部视觉编码器未能捕捉到这种有选择性的敏感性,在两个物体上都表现出一致的低响应(0.28 0.28对0.270.27),同样也错过了人类对简单球面光向变化的敏感性(图1 B). 反之,人类和模型的反应在反射颜色上存在差异:虽然人类强烈地惩罚了微妙的不匹配,但基因模型的敏感性相对较弱。

blocks.en: Spatial loss-difference maps reveal where violation penalties arise across the scene (Figure 2 ). For upright Thatcher faces, loss increases concentrated around the inverted eyes and mouth, with marked attenuation under face inversion. For illumination interventions, loss increases were not confined to manipulated regions, extending from floor surfaces to objects directly above altered shadows or reflections, and from the central object to unmodified flanking objects under light-direction shifts. These maps indicate that generative models evaluate contextual relationships across the scene rather than isolated local modifications.
blocks.zh: 空间损耗-偏差图显示在全场发生违规处罚的地方(图2)。 对于直立的撒切尔面孔来说,损失增加集中在倒向的眼睛和口上,在倒向面孔下明显减弱. 就照明干预而言,损失的增加并不局限于被操纵的区域,从地表延伸到被改变的阴影或反射上方的物体,从中央物体延伸到光向转移下的未变形侧翼物体。 这些地图表明基因模型评价整个场景的背景关系,而不是孤立的局部修改.

blocks.en: 4.2 Item-Level Human Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.2 项目级人类调整

blocks.en: Item-level agreement across generative models. We next tested whether these selective sensitivities generalize to continuous, item-level agreement across the full 25-model benchmark. Across individual stimulus pairs, directional loss changes ( u m , i = L m ​ ( x i mod ) − L m ​ ( x i orig ) u_{m,i}=L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}})-L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}}) ) reliably tracked continuous human unnaturalness ratings ( h i h_{i} ), with median Pearson correlations of .747 .747 on Thatcher (peaking at .841 .841 ) and .334 .334 on Illumination (peaking at .639 .639 ; Figure 3 A). This alignment was not driven merely by coarse mean differences across conditions: after condition centering (subtracting condition-specific means from both model losses and human ratings to isolate item-level rankings within each condition), correlations remained positive for all 25 models on both tasks (medians of .411 .411 and .271 .271 ; peaking at .534 .534 and .619 .619 ; condition breakdowns in Appendix H ). In sharp contrast, unconditioned single-image losses ( L m ​ ( x ) L_{m}(x) ) showed little correlation with human ratings (25-model medians of − .20 -.20 to .24 .24 ; Appendix F.2 ), confirming that paired differencing is essential to separate relational naturalness from shared scene composition.
blocks.zh: 跨基因模型的项目级协议. 我们接下来测试这些选择性的敏感性是否概括到整个25个模式基准的连续、项目级协议。 各个刺激对,方向损失变化(u m,i = L m (x i mod)) - L m (x i orig ) u_{m (x_{i}^{\ mathrm{mod}})-L_{m (x_{i}^{\i}^{\ mathrm{orig}})) 可靠地跟踪人类连续非自然收视率(h ii_{i}i}),皮尔逊在撒切尔的中位关系为747.747(峰值为841.841)和334(峰值为639.639;图3 A). 这种调整不仅仅是由各种条件之间的粗糙平均差异所驱动的:在条件中心化之后(从模型损失和人评分中减去特定条件的手段,以孤立每个条件内的项目等级排名),所有25个模式在两项任务中的相关性仍然是正数(介于411.411和2.71.271的介质;峰值为534.534和619 6.19;附录H中的情况细分)。 与之形成鲜明对比的是,无条件的单相片损失(L mi (x) L_{m} (x))与人类的收视率(25个型号中位数为--20-20至-24.24;附录F.2)几乎没有多大关联,证实对等差异对于将关系自然性与共享场景组成区分开来至关重要.

blocks.en: Notably, human alignment was observed across diverse generative formulations (diffusion versus flow), modeling spaces (pixel versus latent), and modalities (image versus video), with substantial within-category variation (model-wise breakdowns across conditions in Figure S12 ; model specifications in Table S1 ). Furthermore, high alignment emerged in models whose training recipes include no explicit preference optimization (e.g., RLHF or DPO). On Thatcher, class-conditional JiT models ( Li & He, 2026 ) trained solely on ImageNet exhibited alignment that scaled systematically with model capacity (reaching r = .577 r=.577 for JiT-H/32), alongside strong agreement in SD v1.5 ( r = .825 r=.825 ). On Illumination, Wan2.1 14B ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) achieved the highest overall correlation ( r = .639 r=.639 , remaining .619 .619 after condition centering), with solid alignment also sustained in video models such as CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . These findings indicate that perceptual alignment with human naturalness judgments emerges directly from learning visual data distributions.

blocks.en: Comparison with visual encoder and IQA baselines. Across both tasks, top generative models achieved higher human alignment than all evaluated baselines (Figure 3 A), even after selecting each encoder’s best-performing layer (top-five median r = .816 r=.816 vs. .660 .660 on Thatcher; .602 .602 vs. .492 .492 on Illumination). In contrast, standard image quality metrics showed substantially weaker correspondence: NR-IQA correlations remained near zero throughout ( .087 .087 on Thatcher, .009 .009 on Illumination), arguing against generic degradation or manipulation artifacts, while weak FR-IQA results ( .103 .103 and .254 .254 ) indicate that alignment is not driven merely by low-level change magnitude.
blocks.zh: 与视觉编码器和IQA基线的比较. 在这两项任务中,顶级基因模型比所有评估的基线(图3 A)都实现了更高的人类配比(图3 A),甚至在选择了每个编码器的性能最好的地层(Top-5中位数 r = 816 r = 816 vs. 660;图602 602 vs. 492  492 vs. Illumination)之后也是如此。 相形之下,标准图像质量度量表显示的对应性明显弱:NR-IQA的关联性在整个过程中保持了近于零(撒切尔为.087.087;伊略米化为.009.009),反对通用降解或操纵文物;而弱的FR-IQA结果(103.103和254.254)则表明对接不仅仅是由低级变化幅度所驱动.

blocks.en: Bidirectional partial correlations with baselines. Generative scores also retained robust positive residual associations after controlling for baseline metrics in bidirectional partial correlation analyses (Figure 3 B). Controlling for standard IQA metrics had little effect on generative alignment (medians of r ⁡ ( h , G ∣ IQA ) = .809 r(h,G\mid\mathrm{IQA})=.809 – .825 .825 on Thatcher and .535 .535 – .602 .602 on Illumination), while IQA residual associations remained near or below zero ( − .160 -.160 to .106 .106 ), confirming that generative signals do not simply reflect low-level degradation or distortion magnitude. When evaluated alongside frozen vision encoders, generative scores likewise preserved positive residual associations. On Thatcher, generative scores retained strong incremental explanatory power (median partial correlation of .676 .676 , 95% CI [ .612 , .701 ] [.612,.701] vs. .130 .130 , [ .054 , .228 ] [.054,.228] for encoders), whereas on Illumination, both representations retained substantial non-redundant associations ( .510 .510 for generative models vs. .375 .375 for encoders), demonstrating complementary perceptual structure. Broken down by condition, generative scores contributed distinct variance for upright faces, cast shadows, and light direction, while encoders retained larger associations for surface reflections (Figure S14 , Appendix I ). Together, these results indicate that native generative loss landscapes capture human-aligned perceptual regularities that are distinct from standard quality metrics and complementary to discriminative visual encoders.

blocks.en: 4.3 Coupling and Dissociation of Sensitivity and Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.3 敏感性和一致性的结合和分离

blocks.en: Cross-model association. To test whether human alignment simply reflects stronger violation detection, we examined whether models with greater violation sensitivity also showed closer human alignment, evaluating this relationship both across each task as a whole and within individual stimulus conditions (Figure 4 ). Across the full benchmark, violation sensitivity exhibited an overall positive association with item-level human alignment (Figure 4 A; Thatcher: r = .663 r=.663 , 95% CI [ .086 , .905 ] [.086,.905] ; Illumination: r = .821 r=.821 , [ .542 , .922 ] [.542,.922] ), with larger models generally clustering toward the upper right (Appendix K , Figure S19 ). Within individual conditions (Figure 4 B), positive associations were robust for cast shadows ( r = .810 r=.810 , 95% CI [ .424 , .960 ] [.424,.960] ) and inverted faces ( r = .723 r=.723 , [ .118 , .923 ] [.118,.923] ). For upright faces, the point estimate remained positive but carried wide estimation uncertainty ( r = .667 r=.667 , [ − .215 , .904 ] [-.215,.904] ), whereas associations were near zero for light direction ( r = .051 r=.051 , [ − .417 , .570 ] [-.417,.570] ) and negative for surface reflections ( r = − .371 r=-.371 , [ − .704 , .364 ] [-.704,.364] ; Appendix H ). Thus, while sensitivity and alignment covary across each task as a whole, this coupling is not uniform across individual stimulus conditions.

blocks.en: Dissociation along denoising schedules. Within individual models, violation sensitivity and human alignment systematically peak at different stages of the denoising schedule (Figure 5 A,B). Across normalized schedules ( [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ), sensitivity peaked later (at cleaner noise levels) than human alignment in 20 of 25 models on Thatcher and in all 25 models on Illumination, with median within-model peak shifts of 0.141 0.141 and 0.444 0.444 (condition breakdowns in Appendix N ). This separation is consistent with the coarse-to-fine dynamics of generative diffusion ( Sclocchi et al., 2025 ; Tınaz et al., 2025 ; Görgün et al., 2026 ) : human alignment on relational tasks may peak at intermediate noise levels where global layout and contextual consistency are resolved, whereas later stages emphasize fine details that inflate loss penalties without refining perceptual agreement.

blocks.en: Connection to practical generation performance. Finally, as an exploratory analysis, we investigated whether loss-based perceptual alignment connects to practical generative capabilities (Appendix L ). We matched 11 image models to human-preference Elo ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) and seven video models to VBench Quality ( Huang et al., 2024 ) (Table S4 ). Model-level Spearman correlations between generation benchmarks and human alignment were positive on Illumination for image models ( ρ = .827 \rho=.827 ) and across both tasks for video models ( ρ = .929 \rho=.929 on Thatcher, ρ = .821 \rho=.821 on Illumination; Table S5 ), and these associations remained positive after controlling for violation sensitivity (partial ρ = .670 \rho=.670 for image models; .900 .900 and .778 .778 for video models). In contrast, the association on Thatcher images was weak both before and after adjustment ( ρ = .191 \rho=.191 and .182 .182 ), which may reflect ceiling effects as many models approach human-level agreement on faces (Figure 4 A). Conversely, reciprocal associations between generation benchmarks and violation sensitivity after controlling for alignment were uniformly weak across all four comparisons ( ρ = − .045 \rho=-.045 to .218 .218 ). While based on modest sample sizes, these exploratory associations suggest that loss-based perceptual alignment may reflect visual regularities that support practical generation quality.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: This study evaluated whether the native prediction losses of visual generative models reflect human naturalness perception under controlled relational modifications. Across diverse architectures, zero-shot loss differences track continuous human ratings and retain complementary perceptual structure beyond standard vision encoders and image quality metrics. While coarse violation sensitivity broadly covaries with perceptual alignment across models, sensitivity and fine-grained alignment systematically dissociate along denoising schedules and vary across visual domains. These findings suggest that current generative models internalize structured relational regularities that partially mirror the selective sensitivities and tolerances of human naturalness perception, rather than merely signaling physical violations or generic visual divergence. Beyond characterizing existing architectures, this diagnostic framework provides a foundation to track how generative representations converge toward or diverge from biological perception as models scale.
blocks.zh: 这项研究评价了视觉基因模型的原生预测损失是否反映了在受控关系修改下人类的自然感知. 在整个不同的架构中,零发失差跟踪人类的持续收视率,并保留超过标准视觉编码器和图像质量度量的互补感知结构. 虽然粗糙的侵犯敏感度与不同模型的感知一致,但敏感度和精细的调整则有系统地脱离去名表,并因视觉领域而异。 这些研究结果表明,目前的基因模型将结构化的关系规律内化,部分地反映了人类自然感知的选择性敏感性和耐受性,而不只是表示物理侵犯或一般视觉差异. 除了描述现有结构外,这一诊断框架还提供了一个基础,用以跟踪基因表达如何作为模型与生物认知趋同或相去甚远。

blocks.en:
Orientation dependence in face perception. Human sensitivity to relational facial distortions deteriorates sharply under inversion, a hallmark effect exemplified by the Thatcher illusion ( Thompson, 1980 ; de Haas & Schwarzkopf, 2018 ) .
While this orientation dependence is known to emerge in feedforward networks ( Jacob et al., 2021 ) and was observed in our encoder baselines (Figure 1 B), generative models capture human judgments far more closely.
Top generative models markedly outperform even layer-optimized encoders in human alignment on Thatcher, and bidirectional partial correlations confirm that they retain substantial explanatory power that encoder representations cannot account for (Figure 3 ).
Notably, the ImageNet-trained JiT models ( Li & He, 2026 ) demonstrate that this orientation penalty can arise without training on a dedicated face dataset, scaling systematically with model capacity (Appendix G ).
Generative losses also track naturalness variations within upright faces alone (median r = .493 r=.493 ), echoing findings that generative evidence tracks human facial attractiveness ( López & Triesch, 2026 ) .
These results demonstrate that key characteristics of human face perception can emerge directly from statistical generative modeling of 2D images.
blocks.zh:
脸部感知的定向依赖. 人类对关系面部扭曲的敏感度在倒置下急剧恶化,而撒切尔幻觉(Thompson,1980;de Haas & Schwarzkopf,2018)就是这一标志性效应的例证.
虽然这种取向依赖性已知在向导网络中出现(Jacob等人,2021年),并在我们的编码基线(图1 B)中被观察到,但基因模型更紧密地捕捉了人类的判断.
顶端基因模型在撒切尔上人类对接时显著地超越了甚至地层优化编码器,而双向部分关联证实它们保留了编码器表示无法解释的巨大解释力(图3).
值得注意的是,ImageNet训练的JiT模型(Li & He, 2026年)表明,如果不在专用面相数据集上进行培训,就可能出现这种取向性惩罚,并系统化地以模型容量(Appendix G.
遗传性损失还追踪了仅直立面部的自然性变化(中度r = 493 r = 493),与遗传性证据跟踪人类面部吸引力的结论(López & Triesch, 2026)相呼应.
这些结果显示,人类面相感知的关键特征可以从2D图像的统计基因模型中直接出现.

blocks.en:
Physical scene illumination. In our Illumination experiments, human sensitivity to shadow and reflection inconsistencies depended strongly on scene geometry (Figure 1 B): observers readily detected violations for objects with distinctive directional landmarks (e.g., teapot), but tolerated errors for shapes lacking prominent spatial asymmetries (e.g., Spot).
This selective sensitivity aligns with psychophysical accounts where directional landmarks facilitate spatial feature matching ( Casati, 2008 ; Farid & Bravo, 2010 ; Nightingale et al., 2019 ; Norman et al., 2009 ) .
Generative losses systematically tracked this geometric selectivity across shadow and reflection rotations as well as lighting directions (Figure 1 B, Appendix J ), suggesting that rather than acting as objective detectors of physical violations, models rely on statistical correspondence cues that mirror human perceptual heuristics.
However, models show a much weaker response to reflection hue shifts than humans do (Figure 1 B).
While humans treat an impossible reflection color as a decisive physical violation, generative losses appear to penalize it only as a modest color difference relative to geometric misalignments.
This divergence suggests that native loss landscapes may internalize relevant relational cues without weighting them in line with human perception.
blocks.zh:
物理场景照明. 在我们的光照实验中,人类对影子和反射不一致的敏感度在很大程度上取决于场景几何(图1 B):观察者很容易发现有明显方向地标(如取茶壶)的物体的侵犯,但对缺乏显著空间不对称的形状(如斑点)却容忍了错误.
这种选择性的敏感性与可促进空间特征匹配的方向地标的心理物理账户相吻合(Casati,2008;Farid & Bravo,2010;Nightingale等,2019;Norman等,2009)。
遗传性损失系统地跟踪这种几何选择性,跨越阴影和反射旋转以及照明方向(图1 B,附录J),表明模型不是作为物理侵犯的客观探测器,而是依赖于反映人类感知的休眠症的统计对应提示.
然而,模型显示,对反射变化的反应比人类要弱得多(图1 B)。
虽然人类将不可能的反射色视为决定性的身体侵犯,但基因损失似乎仅作为相对于几何错配的微小颜色差异来惩罚.
这种差异表明,原生损失地貌可能使相关关系提示内在化,而不会按照人类的认知对其进行加权。

blocks.en:
Model scaling and perceptual alignment. One might expect that scaling model capacity would steadily resolve such discrepancies, bringing models closer to an ideal observer of physical violations that automatically aligns with human perception.
In exploratory comparisons, whole-task alignment did scale positively with model size (Appendix K , Figure S19 ), but this relationship did not uniformly extend to judgments within individual conditions.
Most notably, for surface reflections, larger models grew steadily more sensitive to violations without showing any improvement in human alignment (Figure S21 ).
This dissociation suggests that heightened sensitivity to visual perturbations does not guarantee alignment with the selective tolerances and weightings of human perception.
blocks.zh:
模型缩放和视觉相接. 人们可能期望,规模化模型能力能够稳步地解决这种差异,使模型更接近一个理想的、自动与人类感知相适应的身体侵害观察者。
在探索性比较中,全任务对接确实与模型大小(Appendix K,图S19)有正比分,但这种关系并没有统一扩展到个别条件下的判断.
最值得注意的是,在地表反射方面,较大的模型对侵权行为越来越敏感,而没有显示人与人之间的一致有任何改善(图S21)。
这种分解表明,对视觉扰动的敏感度提高并不能保证与人类感知的选择性能耐和分量一致.

blocks.en:
Limitations. Several limitations qualify these conclusions.
First, our psychophysical intervention framework isolates relational regularities by minimizing low-level confounds, but this comes at the expense of scene diversity; extending controlled manipulations to unconstrained natural imagery without introducing low-level artifacts remains challenging.
Second, because we evaluate off-the-shelf models, our comparisons cannot fully isolate core generative objectives from differences in model scale, architecture, or post-training recipes, nor can they disentangle generic visual statistics from human-curated preferences in modern training corpora.
Finally, our analyses linking perceptual alignment to downstream generation benchmarks are observational, leaving open whether directly optimizing for human-aligned relational priors causally improves generation quality.
blocks.zh:
限制。 这些结论有若干限制。
首先,我们的心理物理干预框架通过最大限度地减少低层次的混乱来隔离关系规律,但这是以场景多样性为代价的;在不引进低层次的文物的情况下,将控制下的操纵扩大到不受约束的自然图像,仍然是一项挑战。
其次,因为我们评价现成的模型,我们的比较无法将核心基因目标与模型尺度、架构或培训后食谱的差异完全隔离开来,它们也无法将通用视觉统计与现代培训公司中人性化偏好区分开来。
最后,我们的分析将概念上与下游发电基准挂钩,是观察性的,使人们无法了解是否直接优化人与人之间的关系,从而因果地提高了发电质量。

blocks.en: Source face images were sampled from the Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) dataset ( Karras et al., 2019 ) , which provides aligned 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 portraits. Source images were restricted to entries marked CC0 1.0 or Public Domain Mark 1.0 in the official FFHQ metadata ( ffhq-dataset-v2.json ). blocks.en: To generate Thatcherized faces, we adapted the open-source pipeline by Alimohammadi (2020) (released under the GNU General Public License v3.0). For each face image, 68 facial landmarks were detected using dlib ( King, 2009 ) with its pre-trained shape predictor ( Kazemi & Sullivan, 2014 ) (Figure S1 A). Landmarks corresponding to the left eye (points 36–41), right eye (points 42–47), and mouth (points 48–67) were used to define bounding regions with modest padding offsets around each feature (Figure S1 B, dashed rectangles). Within each feature region, pixels inside an elliptical mask were vertically inverted in place across the feature’s horizontal midline (Figure S1 B, solid ellipses). To minimize high-contrast seam artifacts and artificial edges, Gaussian blending feathered the transition along the elliptical perimeter into the surrounding skin. Inverted stimuli were generated by rotating both the original and Thatcherized images by 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} (Figure S1 C).

blocks.en: A.2 Illumination scenes.
blocks.zh: A.2照明场景.

blocks.en: We generated synthetic 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 stimuli using Kubric ( Greff et al., 2022 ) across three physical operations: cast shadows ( Shadow ), surface reflections ( Reflection ), and lighting direction ( Light direction ). Each operation comprised 48 base configurations. Horizontally mirroring each base pair produced another 48 pairs, yielding 96 pairs per operation and 288 pairs in total.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Kubric(Greff等, 2022年)通过三个物理操作生成了合成的1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024刺激: 投影(Shadow ),地表反射(Reflection ),和照明方向(光向). 每个行动包括48个基本配置。 水平反射出每对基对又产生出48对,每次操作可产生96对和288对.

blocks.en: In Shadow and Reflection , we horizontally flipped the floor region while leaving the objects unchanged, exchanging their shadows or reflections (Figure S2 ). The two objects were placed symmetrically about the image’s vertical midline, so the flip mapped their positions onto one another without introducing a positional offset. Additionally, objects were elevated above the floor (see below) to ensure a spatial gap; if objects contacted the ground, swapping the floor would alter contact contours or introduce spurious edge discontinuities at the object base, confounding loss differences with low-level edge artifacts. In Light direction , we horizontally flipped the central object while leaving the floor and flanking objects unchanged. This reversed its shading relative to the flanking objects and, in low-height scenes, disrupted the correspondence between its shading and its unchanged cast shadow. Every intervention rearranged existing pixels without adding newly rendered visual content.

blocks.en: B.1 Apparatus and display interface

blocks.en: Online psychophysical experiments were developed using jsPsych (v7) ( de Leeuw et al., 2023 ) and hosted on a dedicated web server. Prior to starting the experiment, participants were required to switch their browsers to full-screen mode, and automated checks verified compatible rendering environments. Stimuli were displayed in the center of the screen at 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels against a neutral background.
blocks.zh: 在线心理物理实验是利用jsPsych(v7)(de Leeuw等,2023年)开发的,主机为专用网络服务器. 在开始实验前,要求参与者将浏览器切换为全屏模式,并进行自动化检查验证相容的渲染环境. Stimuli被显示在屏幕中心,以512×512 512\times 512像素为中性背景.

blocks.en: Participants provided naturalness ratings on a discrete 5-point horizontal slider with text labels: 1 ( Very unnatural ), 2 ( Unnatural ), 3 ( Slightly unnatural ), 4 ( Moderately natural ), and 5 ( Natural ). To avoid anchoring effects, the slider handle was initialized to a random integer position ( 1 ​ – ​ 5 1\text{--}5 ) on every trial. Participants had to click or move the handle before the continue button was enabled, so that retaining the initial position required an active response. Stimuli remained on screen without time limits until submitted, followed by a 500 ms blank inter-trial interval (ITI).
blocks.zh: 参与者在有文字标签的离散5分水平滑行器上提供自然性评级: 1 (非常不自然.), 2 (非自然.), 3 (略不自然.), 4 (中度自然.), 5 (自然.). 为了避免锚定效应,滑动手柄被初始化为每次试验时的随机整数位置(1–5 1\text{-}5). 在继续按钮启用之前,参与者必须点击或移动手柄,这样保留初始位置需要积极响应. 在提交之前,刺激措施在屏幕上没有时间限制,随后是500毫秒的空白审判间隔。

blocks.en: B.2 Task instructions
blocks.zh: B.2 任务指示

blocks.en: Because the stimulus manipulations introduced subtle violations of configural or physical regularities within otherwise realistic scenes, relying solely on an unguided, generic query of “naturalness” risks inattentive oversights or idiosyncratic evaluation criteria (e.g., judging superficial photographic aesthetics rather than physical plausibility). To ensure that participants attended to the critical structural attributes and to calibrate rating criteria across observers, participants were familiarized with the candidate manipulation types through illustrated instructions and visual examples prior to the experiment: – Thatcher task: Participants were instructed: “Rate the naturalness of the facial appearance on a 5-point scale. Internal facial parts (eyes and mouth) may have artificial image manipulations applied. If you perceive a natural face without manipulation, select 5 (Natural). If you feel unnaturalness due to manipulation, select 1–4 according to the degree of unnaturalness. Faces may also appear upside down; please evaluate them using the same criteria, and refrain from physically tilting your head or rotating your display.” – Shadow swap: Participants were instructed: “Rate the naturalness of the shadow shape formed on the floor surface on a 5-point scale. If the shadow shape appears consistent with the object shape, select 5 (Natural). If the shadow shape appears inconsistent with the object shape, select 1–4 according to the perceived unnaturalness.” – Reflection swap: Participants were instructed: “Rate the naturalness of the reflection on the floor surface on a 5-point scale. If the appearance of the reflected image matches the physical object, select 5 (Natural); if it does not match, select 1–4 according to the degree of unnaturalness.” – Light-direction swap: Participants were instructed: “In an image depicting three objects illuminated from above, rate the naturalness of the lighting on the central object on a 5-point scale, focusing on whether the lighting direction on the central object is consistent with the surrounding objects and the floor shadows. If the lighting direction is mutually consistent, select 5 (Natural); if it appears contradictory, select 1–4 according to the degree of unnaturalness.”
blocks.zh: 由于刺激操纵在原本现实的场景中引入了微妙地侵犯外貌或物理规律的行为,完全依赖于对"自然"的无指向性,泛泛的质疑,风险是无意识地监督或特质评价标准(例如判断表面相片美学而不是物理上的合理性). 为确保参与者关注关键的结构属性并校准观察者的评级标准,参与者在实验前通过插图说明和视觉例子熟悉了候选操纵类型:-撒切尔任务: 参与者被指示:"将面部外观的自然性按5分比例进行调整. 内部面部部分(眼和口)可能采用人工图像操纵. 如果你不操纵地看到自然相,请选择5 (自然相). 如果因为操纵而感到不自然,请根据不自然的程度选择1–4. 脸部也可能出现倒挂;请使用同样的标准来评价,不要在身体上倾斜你的头部或旋转你的显示。” - 阴影交换: 与会者被告知:“将地表所形成的阴影外形的自然性按5分比例排列。 如果阴影形状与对象形状相符合,请选择5 (自然). 如果阴影外形与物体外形不一致,则根据所感知到的不自然性选择1–4". - 反射交换: 与会者得到指示:“以5分比例将反射的自然性放在地表。 如果反射图像的外观与物理对象相匹配,请选择5(自然);如果不匹配,请根据非自然程度选择1-4。” - 光向交换: 与会者被指示:“在描绘从上面取出的三个物体的图像中,将中心物体上照明的自然性按5分比例评定,重点是中心物体上的照明取向是否与周围物体和地板阴影一致。 如果照明方向相互一致,请选择5(自然);如果看起来矛盾,请根据不自然的程度选择1–4. “

blocks.en: The 140 base face scenes ( 140 × 2 ​ orientations = 280 ​ pairs 140\times 2\text{ orientations}=280\text{ pairs} ; 560 images) were divided into four disjoint sets of 35 (A–D). The four observer groups viewed A upright and B inverted, B upright and C inverted, C upright and D inverted, or D upright and A inverted. Each participant therefore viewed 35 upright faces and 35 different inverted faces, with each identity presented in only one orientation. Both original and modified versions of each scene were evaluated by the same participant, providing within-subject paired perceptual differences h i = R ⁡ ( x i orig ) − R ⁡ ( x i mod ) h_{i}=R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}})-R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}}) . Each main block contained 140 trials (35 upright faces plus 35 different inverted faces, each shown in original and modified versions) and 6 repeated trials for reliability checking (146 trials total). In data processing, repeated trials were deduplicated by retaining the first presentation.

blocks.en: The three illumination interventions (Shadow, Reflection, Light direction; 96 scenes each, 288 pairs total) were evaluated in a between-subjects design: each participant evaluated only one intervention type. Within each intervention, the 96 scenes were randomly divided into four disjoint subsets of 24. Each of four observer groups evaluated a different combination of three subsets (72 scenes), so each scene was evaluated by three of the four groups. Both original and modified versions of each assigned scene were evaluated within-subject. blocks.en: Participants were adults aged 20–49 years, with balanced representation across age groups (20s, 30s, and 40s) and sexes. A total of 162 participant submissions were collected for the Thatcher task and 167 for the Illumination task. Since two Illumination submissions came from duplicate participant identities, we retained each participant’s first submission while discarding the latter, leaving 165 participants before response-consistency screening. Although the experiment included 6 repeated trials originally intended for intra-subject test–retest screening, strict consistency filtering on these few trials proved overly conservative due to normal perceptual rating jitter on the 5-point scale, excluding an unnecessarily large fraction of otherwise attentive participants. We therefore adopted a global response-consistency screening criterion. Repeated trials were deduplicated by retaining the first presentation, and for each participant, we computed the Pearson correlation r r between their ratings across unique images and the corresponding image-wise mean ratings of all other participants who rated those images.
blocks.zh: 参加者是20至49岁的成年人,各年龄组(20岁、30岁和40岁)和性别的比例均相当。 为撒切尔任务收集了162份与会者意见,为照明任务收集了167份。 由于两份照明材料来自重复的参与者身份,我们保留了每个参与者的第一次提交,同时放弃了后者,在进行反应一致性筛选之前留下了165名参与者。 虽然试验包括了原先准备在主体内进行测试-再测试筛选的6次重复试验,但由于在5分比额表上正常的认知评级紧张,对这几起试验进行严格的一致性过滤证明过于保守,不必要地排除了相当大一部分本来认真的参与者。 因此,我们通过了一项全球反应一致性筛选标准。 重复的试验由于保留了第一个演示文稿而变得复杂;对于每个参与者,我们计算出他们对独特图像的评级与所有其他参与者对这些图像评级的相应图像平均评级之间的皮尔逊关系。

Each source RGB image was resized by bilinear interpolation to fit the model’s input resolution (Table S1 ), preserving aspect ratio, then center-padded with a constant value of .5 .5 . The padded frame was repeated to form a static clip. CogVideoX1.5 uses 21 repeats to yield six latent frames, satisfying its two-frame temporal patch size; the other eight models use 17.

blocks.en: To benchmark generative loss against non-generative alternatives, we evaluate a heterogeneous pool of 12 frozen image encoders alongside two prespecified five-metric IQA batteries (full-reference and no-reference; Table S3 ). All model weights and scoring protocols are held fixed without task-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 为了比照非遗传性替代品衡量基因损失,我们评估了12个冷冻图像编码器以及两个预先指定的5个计量的IQA电池(全面参照和不参照;表S3)。 所有模型权重和评分协议均被固定,不进行特定任务的微调.

blocks.en: Encoders were selected by predefined criteria independent of observed human alignment to represent standard anchors (ResNet-50, CLIP, and DINOv2), diverse pretraining objectives, varying model scales (0.024B–8.145B parameters), and within-family scaling pairs (e.g., Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B vs. 8B, PE-Core B/16 vs. G/14). The resulting pool consists of 12 frozen encoders spanning supervised classification (ResNet-50; He et al., 2016 ), self-supervised visual representation learning (DINOv2, DINOv3; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ), and contrastive image–language alignment (CLIP, SigLIP 2, PE-Core, Jina CLIP v2; Radford et al., 2021 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ; Bolya et al., 2025 ; Koukounas et al., 2024 ). Qwen3-VL-Embedding provides a multimodal embedding baseline trained for representation extraction, using the representation of the last valid input token ( Li et al., 2026 ).
blocks.zh: 编码器是根据预先确定的标准选择的,独立于观察到的人类对接(ResNet-50,CLIP,和DINOv2),代表标准锚地,不同的训练前目标,不同的模型尺度(0.024B–8.145B参数),以及家族内部的缩放对(例如:Qune3-VL-Embedding 2B vs. 8B,PE-Core B/16 vs. G/14). 由此产生的集合包括12个涵盖监督分类的冷冻编码器(ResNet-50;He等,2016年),自我监督的视觉表现学习(DINOv2,DINov3;Oquab等,2024年;Siméoni等,2026年),以及对比图像-语言对接(CLIP,SigLIP 2,PE-Core,Jina CLIP v2;Radford等,2021年;Tschannan等,2025年;Bolya等,2025年;Koukonas等,2024年)。 Qune3-VL-Embedding提供了一种多模式嵌入基线,为代表物提取提供了训练,使用最后一个有效输入符的表示(Li等,2026.

blocks.en: Because the 12 encoders differ in their internal architectures (spanning convolutional feature maps, Vision Transformers with or without class tokens, and multimodal language decoders), extracting comparable representations ϕ m ​ ℓ ​ ( x ) \phi_{m\ell}(x) requires architecture-specific readout rules. We hold these readout rules fixed across all blocks and tasks. Below, we specify how representations are extracted across three structural groups: models using direct global pooling or unprojected class tokens (ResNet-50, CLIP, and PE-Core); models evaluated via spatially matched patch-token distances (DINOv2 and DINOv3); and models using terminal pooling, projection, or normalization transformations (SigLIP 2, Jina CLIP v2, and Qwen3-VL-Embedding).

blocks.en: ResNet-50 uses spatial global average pooling after each of its 16 bottleneck blocks, without the classification head. CLIP uses the block’s unprojected [CLS] token, without the terminal LayerNorm or projection. This choice follows the default unnormalized intermediate-feature convention in OpenCLIP, while retaining the original OpenAI CLIP checkpoint. PE-Core uses the spatial mean of block tokens after excluding prefix tokens, without terminal normalization or attention pooling. The PE feature API exposes unnormalized intermediate tokens; their spatial averaging is our fixed aggregation choice. Pooling rules therefore follow the native token structure of each architecture.
blocks.zh: ResNet-50在其16个瓶颈区块中每个区块后使用空间全球平均集合,没有分类头. CLIP 使用该块未预测的 [CLS] 符号, 不使用终端层 Norm 或投影 。 此选择遵循了OpenCLIP中默认的非正态中间特性常规,同时保留了OpenAI CLIP的原始检查点. PE-Core在排除了前缀符号后使用块形符号的空间平均值,没有终端正常化或注意力集中. PE特性 API 暴露出非正态中间信号;它们的空间平均值是我们固定的聚合选择. 因此,集合规则遵循每个建筑的原生象征结构。

blocks.en: For DINOv2 and DINOv3, we apply the pretrained terminal LayerNorm to each candidate block, following the normalized intermediate-feature convention. We then exclude the leading [CLS] token and, for DINOv3, four register tokens. The score is the mean one-minus-cosine distance between corresponding spatial patch tokens. Tokens are not averaged before computing cosine distance, and no self-supervised projection head is used. This preserves a spatially matched comparison under the controlled original–modified pairing.

blocks.en: SigLIP 2 applies its pretrained terminal LayerNorm and learned attention pooling to each block. Jina CLIP v2 applies its terminal normalization, [CLS] extraction, and projection. blocks.en: E.1 Bootstrap resampling and statistical uncertainty
blocks.zh: E.1 重新取样和统计不确定性

blocks.en: To account for sampling uncertainty across both observers and stimuli, primary human-dependent estimates (such as model–human alignment and human violation sensitivity) are evaluated via a nonparametric two-factor bootstrap ( 10,000 10{,}000 draws with fixed random seeds), independently resampling participants and base scenes with replacement. Participants are sampled within each stimulus-assignment group at their original sample sizes. Stimuli are sampled at the level of base scenes: Thatcher stimuli were resampled across the 140 140 face identities (keeping upright and inverted pairs together); Illumination stimuli were resampled at the level of the 48 48 base configurations within each operation, keeping horizontally mirrored variants together. Generative-model sensitivities do not depend on human ratings and are evaluated using base-scene resampling alone. In each iteration, condition means and the task-wide standard deviation denominator ( s m , task s_{m,\mathrm{task}} ) are recomputed dynamically, propagating scaling uncertainty into the resulting estimates. Identical bootstrap draws are shared across all models, conditions, and paired comparisons within each task. Pointwise 95% confidence intervals correspond to the empirical 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles across draws, summarizing sampling variability across observers and stimuli.

blocks.en: To evaluate uncertainty in cross-model sensitivity–alignment correlations while accounting for dependence among related models, we combine the participant-and-scene resampling above with a cluster bootstrap over 11 model families (CogVideoX, FLUX.1, FLUX.2, HiDream, HunyuanVideo, JiT, LTX-Video, PixelGen, Qwen-Image, Stable Diffusion, and Wan). In each of 10,000 10{,}000 iterations, 11 families are sampled with replacement, retaining all models within each selected family to recompute the cross-model correlation. Resampled family draws are held consistent across tasks and conditions. Reported 95% confidence intervals correspond to the pointwise 2.5th–97.5th percentiles across iterations, summarizing joint sampling variability across observers, stimuli, and model families.

blocks.en: E.3 Bidirectional partial correlation analysis
blocks.zh: E.3 双向部分关联性分析

blocks.en: To test whether Generative scores retain human-aligned variation beyond strong frozen encoders and quality metrics, we compare the 25 Generative scores with the 12-encoder pool and the two prespecified five-metric IQA batteries described in Section 3.4 and Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 为了检验基因分数是否保留了超过强冷冻编码器和质量度量的与人相匹配的变异,我们比较了25个基因分数与12个编码器集合以及第3.4节和附录D所描述的两个预先指定的5个计量的IQA电池.

blocks.en: To compare generative models against the strongest non-generative baselines, top-performing models are selected in two steps. First, for each of the 12 frozen encoders, we identify the layer that achieves the highest Pearson correlation with human unnaturalness ratings across the full task (Table S2 ). Second, from the 25 generative models and the 12 selected-layer encoders, we rank models by their correlation with human ratings and retain the top five from each pool. All five metrics in each IQA battery are retained without selection. These selected top-five models and encoder layers are held constant across all analyses within each task, including the condition breakdowns and factor profiles (Appendix I ), ensuring that differences across conditions reflect stimulus properties rather than shifts in model composition.

blocks.en: Appendix F Diagnostic controls on native generative loss
blocks.zh: 附录F 本土基因丧失诊断控制

blocks.en: Generative model loss is heavily sensitive to low-level image complexity and high-frequency statistics ( Nalisnick et al., 2019 ; Serrà et al., 2020 ) . Consequently, paired loss differences ( L modified − L original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}} ) fail to track perceptual naturalness whenever an intervention alters these low-level properties, and unconditioned standalone losses fail to reflect human ratings across differing visual compositions. To evaluate the necessity of content-preserving relational manipulations and paired score differencing, we conducted two diagnostic evaluations: generic low-level distortions alongside element deletion, and standalone single-image loss evaluations.
blocks.zh: 基因模型丢失对低等图像复杂度和高频统计非常敏感(Nalisnick等,2019;Serrà等,2020. 因此,当某项干预改变这些低等特性时,配对损失差异(L修改-L原L_{\mathrm{已修改-L_{\mathrm{原创-L_{\mathrm{原创-)无法跟踪知觉自然性,无条件的独立损失未能反映不同视觉成分的人类评级。 为了评价内容保留关系操纵和对等分数差异的必要性,我们进行了两项诊断性评价:在删除元素的同时进行一般性的低水平扭曲,以及独立的单一图像损失评价。

blocks.en: F.1 Generic distortions on CSIQ and element deletion
blocks.zh: F.1 CSIQ 和元素删除的一般扭曲

blocks.en: To test these limitations, we evaluated paired model loss under two scenarios: generic low-level distortions on the CSIQ benchmark ( Larson & Chandler, 2010 ) and element deletion in synthetic 3D scenes (Figure S10 ).
blocks.zh: 为了测试这些局限性,我们评价了两种情景下的配对模型损失:CSIQ基准的通用低水平扭曲(Larson & Chandler, 2010)和合成3D场景中的元素删除(Figure S10).

(B) Paired lost difference (L被扭曲-L参考 L_{\-mathrm{被扭曲-L_{\-mathrm{被忽略-引用-) – DMOS Pearson在五像素-空间传播模型中每个CSIQ扭曲类型内部的关联.

blocks.en:
First, we tested whether loss differences relative to the reference image ( L distorted − L reference L_{\mathrm{distorted}}-L_{\mathrm{reference}} ) track human quality judgments across standard corruptions using the CSIQ benchmark ( Larson & Chandler, 2010 ) (Figure S10 A). We restricted this evaluation to pixel-space diffusion models (three JiT variants, PixelGen 512, and HiDream-O1-Image) to avoid confounding generative priors with VAE compression characteristics.
Evaluating loss–DMOS correlations within each distortion type reveals a severe statistical bias (Figure S10 B). For distortions that add high-frequency variance (AWGN and pink noise), model loss correlates positively with perceived degradation. In contrast, for distortions that smooth textures or attenuate contrast (blur, JPEG, JPEG 2000, and contrast reduction), the correlation systematically reverses to negative. Because denoising objectives naturally penalize high-frequency variance while favoring smoother images, paired loss differences cannot overcome unconstrained shifts in low-level statistics, rendering native loss ineffective as a general-purpose quality metric.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们测试了与参考图像(L扭曲-L参考L_{\mathrm{distorted}}-L_{\mathrm{Reference}}})相比的损失差异是否使用CSIQ基准(Larson & Chandler, 2010)(图S10 A)跟踪标准腐败对人的质量判断. 我们把这个评价限制在像素-空间扩散模型(3个JiT变体,PixelGen 512和HiDream-O1-Image),以避免与VAE压缩特性相混淆的基因前科.
评估损失-DMOS在每种扭曲类型中的关联性揭示出严重的统计偏差(图S10 B). 对于增加高频差异(AWGN和粉色噪音)的扭曲,模型损失与所觉知的退化有着正比关系。 与此相反,对于平滑的纹理或减弱了对比的扭曲(blur, JPEG, JPEG 2000和对比的还原),关联性系统反向为负. 由于去名目标自然会惩罚高频相差而倾向于平滑图像,配对损失相差无法克服低级统计中不受约束的转变,使本土相差作为通用质量衡量标准无效.

blocks.en: Second, we examined whether altering image content undermines the evaluation of physical consistency. Using 96 rendered 3D scenes, we compared model responses under two shadow manipulations (Figure S10 C): (1) one-shadow deletion , which removes a cast shadow entirely, introducing a physical anomaly while reducing overall image complexity; and (2) shadow swap (our main paradigm), which relocates shadows between objects, creating physical inconsistency while preserving low-level image statistics.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们审查了改变图像内容是否有损于对物理一致性的评价。 利用96已渲染出3D场景,我们比较了两个阴影操纵下的模型响应(图S10 C): (1)一影删除,完全去除被投影,引入了物理异常,同时降低了整体图像复杂度; (2)阴影交换(我们的主要范式),将阴影迁移到对象之间,在保留低等图像统计的同时造成物理上不一致.

blocks.en: Standardized loss differences (defined for this control as the mean paired loss difference divided by the sample standard deviation over the 96 pairs) show distinct patterns between the two manipulations (Figure S10 D). For one-shadow deletion, loss changes were uniformly negative across all models: although removing a shadow makes the scene physically unnatural, the reduced image complexity dominates the loss landscape, causing the model to evaluate the corrupted scene as more probable. In contrast, under shadow swap, preserving low-level statistics mitigates this negative artifact, allowing more capable architectures to exhibit positive loss penalties that reflect sensitivity to the physical inconsistency.
blocks.zh: 标准化损失差异(为本控制所定义为以抽样标准差相除于96对的正对损失差异)显示了两种操纵之间的不同模式(图S10 D). 对于一影删除,损失变化在所有模型中都是一致的负数:虽然去掉一影使得场景在物理上不自然,但降低的图像复杂度支配了损失地貌,使模型对被破坏的场景的评价更加可能. 相形之下,在"阴影互换"中,保留低级统计可以减轻这种负值的文物,使更有能力的建筑能够表现出反映对物理上不一致的敏感性的正损失处罚.

blocks.en: Because condition-level aggregates combine multiple scene properties, they do not isolate which factors drive these agreements and discrepancies. In Appendix J , we break down the Illumination stimuli into specific scene factors (including object shape, orientation, and surface roughness) to examine differences across model classes.
blocks.zh: 由于条件级聚合结合了多个场景属性,它们不会孤立哪些因素驱动这些协议和差异. 在附录J中,我们将照明刺激分为具体的场景因子(包括物体形状,取向和表面粗糙等),以检查不同模型类的差异.

blocks.en: Appendix J Factor-level structure of Illumination judgments
blocks.zh: 附录J 照明判决的系数级结构

blocks.en: While overall evaluations measure aggregate alignment across the full stimulus set, they obscure which specific scene properties accompany human–model consistency or divergence. We therefore examined how perceived unnaturalness and model predictions vary across the object shapes, rotations, colors, and physical parameters of the Illumination stimuli (Appendix A ). We evaluate the task-pooled top-five models (Section 3.4 ): generative models Wan2.1 T2V 14B, Qwen-Image, Wan2.2 T2V A14B, Qwen-Image-2512, and HunyuanVideo (Table S1 ); and encoders PE-Core B/16, PE-Core G/14, CLIP ViT-B/16, SigLIP 2 Base/16, and Jina CLIP v2 (Table S3 ). All five metrics from each IQA battery are also retained. The same model sets are used in the condition-level comparison in Figure S14 .
blocks.zh: 虽然总体评价衡量了整套刺激措施的总体一致性,但它们模糊了人类模式一致性或差异性的具体场景特性。 因此,我们研究了不同物体形状、自转、颜色和物理参数(附录A)的不同感知的非自然性和模型预测。 我们评价了任务集中的五大模型(第3.4节):基因模型Wan2.1 T2V 14B、Quen-Image、Wan2.2 T2V A14B、Quen-Image-2512和HunyuanVideo(表S1);编码器PE-Core B/16、PE-Core G/14、CLIP ViT-B/16、SigLIP 2 Base/16和Jina CLIP v2(表S3)。 每个IQA电池的所有5个度量标准也保留下来. 在图S14中的条件级比较中使用了同一套模型.

blocks.en: Human sensitivity to inconsistencies was strongly modulated by object geometry. In both cast shadows and surface reflections, rotating objects with distinct, familiar axes produced highly salient unnaturalness: Shadow scores reached 0.714 0.714 for the torus and 1.462 1.462 for the teapot (S2), while Spot cow rotations in Reflection elicited similarly marked unnaturalness ( 1.145 1.145 and 1.540 1.540 ; R2). In Shadow, unnaturalness for the Spot cow was much higher when rotations introduced salient 2D contour asymmetry ( 45 ∘ ↔ 90 ∘ 45^{\circ}\leftrightarrow 90^{\circ} : 0.973 0.973 ) than when the 2D silhouette was near mirror-symmetric ( − 45 ∘ ↔ 135 ∘ -45^{\circ}\leftrightarrow 135^{\circ} : 0.170 0.170 ). In contrast, rotating the complex torus knot produced negligible perceived unnaturalness in both Shadow ( − 0.077 -0.077 and 0.013 0.013 ) and Reflection ( 0.018 0.018 and 0.089 0.089 ). Similarly, in Light direction (L1), mirroring the central sphere elicited strong unnaturalness ( 1.805 1.805 ), whereas the same manipulation on the torus knot was virtually unnoticed ( 0.014 0.014 ). Generative models closely tracked this selective sensitivity across both shadows and reflections (median MSE = 0.061 \mathrm{MSE}=0.061 in Shadow rotation, 0.324 0.324 in Reflection rotation, and 0.170 0.170 in Light direction; Figure S15 ). As shown in Figures S16 – S18 , generative scores reproduced the distinction between subtle torus-knot rotations and conspicuous teapot or Spot rotations in both shadow and reflection, as well as the difference between the symmetric and asymmetric Spot shadow configurations. Visual encoders ( MSE = 0.418 \mathrm{MSE}=0.418 – 0.632 0.632 ) and FR-IQA metrics ( 0.645 0.645 – 1.058 1.058 ), by contrast, showed larger discrepancies, responding strongly to torus-knot rotations and lighting changes despite human judgments being near baseline.
blocks.zh: 人类对不一致的敏感性被物体几何学所强烈地调制. 在投影和地表反射中,有独特而熟悉的轴旋转物体产生出非常突出的不自然性: 托鲁斯分数为0.714 0.714分,茶壶分数为1.462 1.462分(S2分),而反射中的Spot牛自转则引出同样被标记为不自然(1.145 1.145分和1.540 1.540分;R2分). 在"阴影"中,当旋转引入了突出的2D等距不对称(45 ∘-90 ∘-45 ^{\-右后卫90 ^{\-右后卫90 ^{\-右后卫:0.973 0.973 )时,Spot牛的不自然性要高得多 (-45 ∘-135 ∘-45 ∘-左后卫135 rc-右后卫:0.170 0.170. 相形之下,旋转复杂的托鲁斯结在阴影(-0.077-0.077和0.0130.013)和反射(0.018-0.018和0.089-0.089)中产生可忽略不计的不自然性。 同样地,在光线方向(L1)中,反射出中央球体引起了强烈的不自然性(1.805 1.805),而对托鲁斯结的同一种操纵几乎无人注意(0.014 0.014)。 基因模型在阴影和反射上密切跟踪这种选择性敏感性(中间MSE = 0.061\mathrm{MSE}=0.061 在阴影旋转中,0.324 0.324在反射旋转中,0.170 0.170在光向;图S15.). 如图S16 — S18所示,基因分数在阴影和反射中重现了微妙的Torus-knot旋转和显性茶壶或Spot旋转之间的区别,以及相对和不对称的Spot阴影配置的区别。 相形之下,视觉编码器(MSE = 0.418\mathrm{MSE}=0.418 – 0.632 0.632)和FR-IQA度量衡(0.645 0.645 – 1.058 1.058)显示出较大差异,尽管人类判断接近基线,但强烈地响应了托鲁斯-克诺特旋转和照明变化.

blocks.en:
In contrast to rotation, human judgments of shape swaps showed consistently salient unnaturalness across all tested pairs in both Shadow (S1: 1.261 1.261 – 1.913 1.913 ) and Reflection (R1: 1.784 1.784 – 2.155 2.155 ). Generative models failed to capture this uniform human intolerance: rather than remaining consistently high, median generative scores varied widely across object geometries in both Shadow ( 0.711 0.711 for Torus ↔ \leftrightarrow gear to 2.597 2.597 for Teapot ↔ \leftrightarrow Spot) and Reflection ( 0.761 0.761 for Cube ↔ \leftrightarrow sphere to 2.789 2.789 for Teapot ↔ \leftrightarrow Spot; Figures S16 – S17 ).
A distinct profile divergence also appeared for reflection color shifts (R3). Whereas human observers judged subtle hue discrepancies as already markedly unnatural ( 1.730 1.730 on Cube, 2.052 2.052 on Torus) with only modest increases for large shifts ( 2.247 2.247 and 2.416 2.416 ), generative models scaled strongly with the magnitude of chromatic discrepancy—remaining largely insensitive to subtle hue deviations ( 0.480 0.480 and 0.431 0.431 ) but surging for large shifts (reaching 2.479 2.479 on Cube). This contrast between threshold-like human sensitivity and continuous, magnitude-scaling generative losses produced the largest generative profile error across all factors (median MSE = 1.292 \mathrm{MSE}=1.292 vs. encoder 1.037 1.037 ). In Reflection shape swaps (R1) as well, encoders aligned more closely with uniform human elevations ( MSE = 0.456 \mathrm{MSE}=0.456 vs. generative 0.753 0.753 ). These factor-level discrepancies suggest why visual encoders retained substantial residual predictive power specifically for surface reflections (Figure S14 ).

blocks.en:
Physical scene parameters also systematically affected human judgments and model predictions.
In cast shadows, human perceived unnaturalness was higher for hard than soft shadows (S4: 1.731 1.731 vs. 0.400 0.400 ) and when objects were placed near the ground (S3: 1.224 1.224 vs. 0.908 0.908 ). Generative models closely tracked both contrasts (median MSE = 0.043 \mathrm{MSE}=0.043 for softness and 0.011 0.011 for height), whereas visual encoders exhibited larger errors ( 0.922 0.922 and 0.530 0.530 ).
Similarly, in surface reflections, human ratings decreased from smooth to rough floors (R5: 2.166 2.166 vs. 1.054 1.054 ) and from low to high object positions (R4: 1.773 1.773 vs. 1.447 1.447 ). All model classes captured these reductions with comparable accuracy ( MSE ≈ 0.09 \mathrm{MSE}\approx 0.09 – 0.18 0.18 ).
In Light direction, human perceived unnaturalness for lighting inconsistencies was higher on diffuse than metallic surfaces (L2: 1.063 1.063 vs. 0.675 0.675 ) and higher for lateral lighting ( 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} ) than overhead lighting ( 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} ; L4: 1.001 1.001 vs. 0.736 0.736 ), contrasts that generative models matched with low error ( MSE ≤ 0.035 \mathrm{MSE}\leq 0.035 ). Finally, for object height in Light direction (L3), height also determined whether floor cast shadows were rendered as a reference cue (present at low height, disabled at high height; Appendix A ). In this condition, human ratings showed little difference between heights ( 0.850 0.850 vs. 0.887 0.887 ), whereas generative models scored higher when cast shadows were present ( 1.070 1.070 vs. 0.615 0.615 , median MSE = 0.104 \mathrm{MSE}=0.104 ; Figure S18 ).

blocks.en: Appendix K Effects of model capacity on sensitivity and human alignment
blocks.zh: 模型能力对敏感度和人与人之间的关系

blocks.en: We evaluated how violation sensitivity and human alignment relate to model capacity across the 25 generative models (Figure S19 ). For generative models, model size is defined as the parameter count of the denoising or flow backbone network used to compute native scores (ranging from 0.14B to 20B parameters).
blocks.zh: 我们评价了25个基因模型(图S19)的侵权敏感性和人与模型能力的关系。 对于基因模型,模型大小被定义为用于计算原生分数(从0.14B到20B等参数)的去诺化或流出骨干网络的参数计数.

blocks.en: Larger generators generally tended to show both stronger violation sensitivity and closer human alignment, though these associations varied across tasks and metrics. Log parameter count correlated positively with violation sensitivity (Thatcher: Pearson r = .741 r=.741 , Spearman ρ = .685 \rho=.685 ; Illumination: r = .831 r=.831 , ρ = .841 \rho=.841 ) and human alignment (Thatcher: r = .627 r=.627 , ρ = .375 \rho=.375 ; Illumination: r = .803 r=.803 , ρ = .796 \rho=.796 ). The weaker rank correlation for Thatcher alignment ( ρ = .375 \rho=.375 ) suggests that while larger models were generally more sensitive, human alignment did not follow model size equally closely across all evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 较大的发电机一般都显示出更敏感的违规感和更紧密的人际结合,尽管这些关联的任务和衡量标准各不相同。 逻辑参数计数与违反敏感性(Thatcher:Pearson r = 741 r = 741;Spearman ë = 685 \rho = 685; Illumination: r = 831 r = 831; ρ 841 \rho = 841)和人对接(Thatcher: r = 627 r = 627; ρ 375 \rho = 375; Illumination: r = 803 r = 803; ρ = 796\rho = 796)呈正比关系,表明虽然更大的模型一般比较敏感,但人类对接没有在所有经过评价的模型上同样遵循模型大小。

blocks.en: To provide an empirical reference over an overlapping parameter range, we also evaluated all 12 frozen vision and multimodal encoders at the layer selected for each task (Table S2 ; 0.02B to 8.1B parameters; Figure S19 , open green diamonds). Encoder size denotes the full scoring network, not the prefix ending at the selected layer. The same standardization (mean feature distance divided by its standard deviation across the task) was applied to unsigned distances, which measure representational divergence rather than directional unnaturalness. At the selected layers, encoder sensitivity was moderately negatively associated with log parameter count on Thatcher and weakly associated on Illumination (Thatcher: r = − .308 r=-.308 , ρ = − .399 \rho=-.399 ; Illumination: r = .090 r=.090 , ρ = .028 \rho=.028 ). Encoder human alignment was positively associated with size on Thatcher ( r = .380 r=.380 , ρ = .322 \rho=.322 ), but weakly associated on Illumination ( r = − .110 r=-.110 , ρ = − .098 \rho=-.098 ). Thus, whereas larger generators show both stronger violation sensitivity and closer human alignment, scaling encoder size does not automatically improve either metric, particularly on Illumination.
blocks.zh: 为了提供重叠参数范围的经验参考,我们还评价了为每项任务选定的层的所有12个被冻结的视野和多模式编码器(表S2;0.02B至8.1B参数;图S19,开口绿钻石)。 编码器大小表示完整的评分网络,而不是在所选层结束的前缀. 同样的标准化(平均特征距离因其整个任务的标准偏差而分出)适用于未签名的距离,这种距离衡量的是代表性差异而不是方向性不自然。 在选定的各层中,编码器的敏感性与撒切尔的对数参数有中度负面联系,在发光上(撒切尔:r = − 30.8 r = - 308 r – - 308 ; ρ- 399; 发光上:r = 090 r = 090; ρ = 028 = 0.28 ) 编码器的人接合与撒切尔的大小(r = 380 r = 380, ρ ρ 322 = 322 )有正相关,但在发光上(r = − 110 r = - 098 °- 0.98 ) , 因此,虽然较大的发电机既显示更强的违反敏感性,也显示更紧密的人类接合,但放大编码器的尺寸并没有自动改善,特别是在发光上。

blocks.en: Decomposing this relationship by stimulus condition (Figures S20 and S21 ) reveals that model capacity affects violation sensitivity and human alignment through distinct trajectories. Violation sensitivity scaled positively with parameter count across nearly all conditions (Thatcher upright: Pearson r = .760 , ρ = .694 r=.760,\rho=.694 ; inverted: r = .697 , ρ = .641 r=.697,\rho=.641 ; cast shadow: r = .790 , ρ = .846 r=.790,\rho=.846 ; surface reflection: r = .783 , ρ = .729 r=.783,\rho=.729 ; light direction: r = .244 , ρ = .191 r=.244,\rho=.191 ), indicating that larger backbones systematically acquire stronger penalties for relational alterations across diverse visual domains. In contrast, human alignment exhibited pronounced domain selectivity: while alignment scaled with capacity for cast shadows ( r = .649 , ρ = .688 r=.649,\rho=.688 ) and light direction ( r = .610 , ρ = .526 r=.610,\rho=.526 ), it showed no positive association with model size for surface reflections ( r = − .256 , ρ = − .104 r=-.256,\rho=-.104 ) and saturated early for upright faces ( r = .516 , ρ = .378 r=.516,\rho=.378 ).
blocks.zh: 通过刺激条件来分解这种关系(图S20和S21),揭示出模型能力通过不同的轨迹来影响侵权敏感性和人与人之间的对接. 违反敏感度随参数计数而呈正比,几乎在所有条件下都存在(Thatcher直立:Pearson r = 760; ρ:694 r = 760;\rho = 694;倒置: r = 697; ρ: 641 r = 697;\rho = 641; 投影: r = 790; ρ: 846 r = 790;\rho = 846; 地表反射: r = 783; ρ: ρ: 729; \: \: .7: 783; \: \: r: r: 2.44; ρ: 19.1; 2.44;\rho; 19.1),表明更大的骨干在不同的视觉领域系统地获得对关系改变的更严厉的惩罚。 相比之下,人类对接表现出明显的域选择性:虽然对接与投影容量(r = 6.49, ë = 6.88 r = 6.649,\rho = 6.88)和光向(r = 6.10, ρ = 526 r = 6.10,\rho = 526)相适应,但与表面反射模型大小(r = -. 256, ρ =-.104 r =-256,\rho =-.104)没有正相干,而且对正脸部的饱和早期(r = 516, = 378 r = 5.16,\rho = 378).

blocks.en: Crucially, the absence of alignment scaling for surface reflections cannot be attributed to human rating noise, as participants exhibited high split-half reliability in this condition ( r = .932 r=.932 ; Appendix E.2 ). Instead, it reflects a genuine divergence between the statistical features captured by generative loss minimization (which readily penalizes surface modifications) and the physical or perceptual criteria humans employ to judge reflection naturalness.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,表面反射没有相配缩放不能归因于人类评级噪音,因为参与者在此条件下表现出高分半可靠性(r=932 r=932;附录E.2). 相反,它反映了将遗传损失减少到最低程度(这很容易惩罚地改变地表)所捕获的统计特征与人类用来判断反映自然的物理或认知标准之间的真正差异。

blocks.en: Appendix L Published generation evaluations and human alignment
blocks.zh: 公布的生成评价和人员配对

blocks.en: We conducted a post-hoc comparison with published generation evaluations to ask whether models’ human alignment in our tasks is associated with broader generation performance, beyond what can be explained by overall violation sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 我们与公布的一代评价进行了一次模拟后比较,询问模型在任务中的人类一致性是否与更广泛的一代业绩有关,超出整体侵权敏感性所能解释的范围。

blocks.en: We evaluated a subset of 11 image and seven video models from our primary sample for which corresponding public benchmark records were available (Table S4 ). Image models are evaluated on Artificial Analysis text-to-image Elo ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) , derived from blinded pairwise human judgments across shared prompts. Video models are evaluated on the automated VBench Quality score ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , which assesses visual and temporal fidelity using pretrained vision models and motion algorithms (spanning consistency, flickering, smoothness, aesthetics, and imaging quality). 1 1 1 Snapshots retrieved September 11, 2026 from https://artificialanalysis.ai/image/leaderboard/text-to-image and https://huggingface.co/spaces/Vchitect/VBench_Leaderboard . blocks.en: As a supplementary check, we added scoring-backbone parameter count P P (Table S4 ) to the sensitivity adjustment. blocks.en: In the main text (Section 4, Figure 5 ), we observed that sensitivity tended to peak later than human perceptual alignment along diffusion denoising schedules. This section provides the underlying evaluation details and complete model-wise data: (1) formal definitions of the profile metrics and schedule coordinates, (2) condition-specific peak comparisons across all 25 models (Figure S28 ), and (3) complete profiles for all evaluated models across conditions (Figures S29 and S30 ).

blocks.en: To test whether our findings depend on empty text conditioning, we compared empty prompts with fixed descriptions of the stimulus content in a representative nine-model panel spanning diverse architectures (Stable Diffusion v1.5, SDXL, SD3, FLUX.1 dev, PixelGen, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B, CogVideoX-2B, and LTX-Video 2B v0.9.0). Prompts described stimulus content (face orientation or a tabletop scene) without mentioning the visual manipulation or judging naturalness, and were identical for both the original and modified images within each pair (Table S7 ). Both prompt conditions were evaluated without classifier-free guidance, using the same timestep grids and noise draws (20 timesteps for image models, 10 for video models; five draws per timestep).

Because the Thatcher prompts specified face orientation, we also assessed alignment within conditions: after removing orientation-specific means, correlations remained positive for all nine models under both prompt conditions. Across these nine models, human-alignment rankings had Spearman correlations of .967 .967 on Thatcher and .983 .983 on Illumination between prompt conditions. blocks.en: Appendix P Control for shared sampling noise
blocks.zh: 附录P 共享取样噪音控制

blocks.en: Violation sensitivity and human alignment are both functions of the same estimated paired scores. Computing both metrics from the same finite noise draws can therefore introduce correlated sampling errors, potentially inflating their cross-model association. Testing this control requires individual per-draw losses. While all 16 image models preserved per-draw losses across 100 timesteps in the primary evaluation, the primary 50-timestep video evaluation did not retain per-draw outputs. We therefore sampled three representative video models (Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B, CogVideoX-2B, and LTX-Video 2B v0.9.0) from a separate 10-timestep evaluation where per-draw losses were recorded, forming a combined panel of 19 models. Both subsets retained 20 draws and all stimulus pairs (280 Thatcher and 288 Illumination).
blocks.zh: 违反敏感性和人与人之间的接合性都是同一估计对等分数的功能. 因此,从相同的有限噪声抽取的两种度量计算都可能引入相关取样错误,有可能夸大其跨模型关联。 测试此控制需要单个每拖取损失. 虽然所有16个图像模型在初级评价中都保留了100个分时段的每拖损,但初级50分时段的视频评价并没有保留每拖损的产出。 因此,我们从一个单独的10个时间步评价中抽取了三个具有代表性的视频模型(Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B, CogVideoX-2B, LTX-Video 2B v0.9.0),其中记录了每笔拖取的损失,组成了由19个模型组成的综合小组. 两个子集保留了20个平面和所有刺激对(280个撒切尔和288个照明).
